name: Chebar
overview: The river Chebar is identified in Scripture as a significant location in Mesopotamia where the prophet Ezekiel received divine visions and revelations during the Babylonian captivity. The passages emphasize that Ezekiel was among the captives by this river when the heavens opened and the glory of the LORD appeared to him, marking it as a place of profound spiritual encounter and prophetic commissioning. The detailed descriptions of the cherubim and living creatures seen by the river underscore the supernatural nature of Ezekiel's experience and the presence of God's glory in exile.
